verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents general card issuing, including virtual cards, and blocking of specific merchants, categories or merchant IDs. Nothing in the evidence documents issuing a scoped card to an AI agent by name. It also shows no per-card amount caps or card expiry controls for autonomous purchases. The 3DS threshold rule is a challenge trigger, not a spend cap, so this is adjacent general issuing functionality rather than the agent-card capability the story requires.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give an agent its own card — issue a scoped virtual card to an AI agent with merchant locks, amount caps, and expiry so autonomous purchases stay inside policy, a use the vendor documents by name
